alt.en: A wet, potholed bus station yard at night, lit by one harsh floodlight, with state buses parked under a large tree and puddles reflecting the light.
alt.hg: Raat mein baarish se bheega, gaddhon wala bus adde ka maidan; ek tez floodlight ki roshni mein bade ped ke neeche sarkari buses khadi hain aur paani ke gaddhon mein roshni jhalak rahi hai.

alt.en: A long railway platform at night under a lit metal roof, with trains standing on both sides, empty benches and only a few distant people.
alt.hg: Raat mein roshan tin ki chhat ke neeche ek lamba railway platform; dono taraf trains khadi hain, benches khaali hain aur door kuch hi log dikh rahe hain.

alt.en: Buses lined up at a dimly lit bus station at night under two bright floodlights, with a few people standing in silhouette on the dark tarmac.
alt.hg: Raat mein kam roshni wale bus adde par line mein khadi buses, upar do tez floodlights, aur andhere maidan mein parchhai jaise dikhte kuch log.

alt.en: A rain-wet, nearly empty city crossing at night, street lamps reflecting in puddles, a lit statue of a rider on horseback in the centre, and one bus and one orange car passing.
alt.hg: Raat mein baarish se bheega, lagbhag sunsaan chauraha; paani ke gaddhon mein streetlight ki chamak, beech mein roshan ghudsawar pratima, aur paas se guzarti ek bus aur ek orange car.

alt.en: Two street lamps glare through falling rain above a mass of tangled overhead cables, dark trees and the side of an apartment building.
alt.hg: Girti baarish ke beech do streetlamp chamak rahe hain; neeche bijli ke taaron ka uljha jaal, andhere ped aur ek apartment building ki deewar.

alt.en: A single street lamp lights up a curtain of heavy rain in the dark; below, one warm window glows behind a metal grille.
alt.hg: Andhere mein akela streetlamp tez baarish ki bauchhaar ko roshan kar raha hai; neeche lohe ki jaali ke peeche ek khidki mein peeli roshni jal rahi hai.

alt.en: A pink floor sign with white flowers and an arrow reads 'Women Only' in Hindi and English, on grey platform tiles beside a yellow safety line and tactile paving.
alt.hg: Platform ki grey tiles par gulabi nishaan, jis par safed phool aur arrow bane hain aur 'Kewal Mahilayen' aur 'Women Only' likha hai; paas mein peeli safety line aur ubhri hui tiles.

alt.en: A metro train blurs past an underground platform where two traffic cones and a red-and-white chain fence off a pink 'Women Only' floor sign; passengers walk away along the platform.
alt.hg: Underground metro platform se tezi se guzarti train; do traffic cone aur laal-safed zanjeer se gulabi 'Women Only' nishaan wala hissa ghera gaya hai, aur kuch yatri platform par aage jaate dikh rahe hain.

alt.en: The empty open doorway of a white-and-purple suburban train coach; beside it a painted sign reads, in Marathi, Hindi and English, '24 HRS. Ladies Only'.
alt.hg: Safed-baingani local train ke dibbe ka khula, khaali darwaza; bagal mein Marathi, Hindi aur English mein likha hai — '24 ghante kewal mahilaon ke liye'.

city-10.author: Adam Jones from Kelowna, BC, Canada

alt.en: A scuffed poster behind a plastic cover at a bus stop shows two green stick figures and one red female figure with raised arms, under the words 'Women are the equal partners of our society. Never neglect or disrespect them.'
alt.hg: Bus stop par plastic cover ke peeche ghisa hua poster: haath uthaye do hari aur ek laal (mahila) aakriti, aur upar English mein likha hai ki mahilayen samaj ki barabar ki bhagidaar hain, unki upeksha ya anaadar kabhi na karein.

alt.en: Seen from above after dark, a packed city road is filled with yellow-green autorickshaws, cars and buses under bright street lights, while dense crowds walk along its edge.
alt.hg: Upar se dikhti andhera hone ke baad ki bheed bhari sadak: tez streetlights ke neeche peele-hare auto-rickshaw, cars aur buses, aur kinare par paidal chalte logon ki ghani bheed.

alt.en: Seen from behind in the dark, several people raise glowing smartphones above their heads to film the night sky, with blurred green, pink and white lights beyond.
alt.hg: Andhere mein peeche se dikhte kai log apne chamakte smartphone sir ke upar utha kar raat ke aasmaan ka video bana rahe hain; aage hari, gulaabi aur safed dhundhli roshniyan hain.

alt.en: Two hands typing in the dark on a laptop keyboard whose keys glow with a cold blue-white backlight.
alt.hg: Andhere mein laptop keyboard par type karte do haath; keyboard ke buttons thandi neeli-safed roshni se chamak rahe hain.

alt.en: An open laptop glows on a rumpled bed in a pitch-dark room, its bright screen the only source of light.
alt.hg: Ghup andhere kamre mein silvaton wale bistar par khula laptop chamak raha hai; uski tez screen hi kamre ki akeli roshni hai.

alt.en: Seen from behind, a person holds up a smartphone in both hands at night, its screen glowing, while blurred coloured lights reflect on dark water beyond.
alt.hg: Raat mein peeche se dikhta ek vyakti dono haathon mein smartphone upar uthaye hue hai; uski screen chamak rahi hai aur aage andhere paani par rangeen dhundhli roshniyan jhalak rahi hain.

alt.en: Close-up of the black frame of a laptop screen, with a small strip of silver duct tape stuck over the built-in webcam.
alt.hg: Laptop screen ke kaale frame ka close-up, jismein andar lage webcam ke upar chaandi rang ki tape ki chhoti patti chipki hai.

alt.en: A blue and white sign with a smiley face reading 'Smile, you are under CCTV' stands in a paved market street lined with shops, with people walking in the distance under a grey sky.
alt.hg: Dukaanon se ghiri pakki bazaar wali gali mein smiley wala neela-safed board laga hai, jis par likha hai 'Smile, you are under CCTV'; door log chal rahe hain aur aasmaan mein baadal chhaye hain.

alt.en: Inside a dim, empty small-town cyber café: a desk with a computer monitor, printer and landline phone faces a window covered with paper signs for internet, e-mail and ticket booking, with hills outside.
alt.hg: Chhote kasbe ka ek dhundhla, khaali cyber cafe: mez par computer monitor, printer aur landline phone rakhe hain; saamne ki khidki par internet, e-mail aur ticket booking ke kaagzi notice chipke hain aur bahar pahaad dikh rahe hain.

alt.en: A low, close view of laptop keys in darkness, their edges glowing gold-white against a black background.
alt.hg: Andhere mein laptop ke buttons ka bahut paas aur neeche se liya gaya close-up; kaali background mein unke kinaare sunehri-safed roshni se chamak rahe hain.

alt.en: A rusted pole against a pale blue sky carries a small solar panel, a grey box labelled 'CCTV Solar Power System' and two white wireless security cameras with antennas.
alt.hg: Halke neele aasmaan ke saamne jang lage khambe par ek chhota solar panel, 'CCTV Solar Power System' likha grey box aur antenna wale do safed wireless security camere lage hain.

alt.en: An empty, dim university classroom with rows of long wooden desks and chairs, three ceiling fans and daylight coming through a wide barred window.
alt.hg: Ek khaali, dhundhli roshni wali university classroom jismein lakdi ki lambi desks aur kursiyon ki kataarein, chhat par teen pankhe aur chaudi jaalidaar khidki se aati dhoop dikh rahi hai.

alt.en: A long, empty hostel corridor at night, lit by ceiling lamps, with a row of closed doors on the left and a dark lawn and a parked bicycle on the right.
alt.hg: Raat mein hostel ka ek lamba, khaali galiyara, chhat ki battiyon se roshan; baayin taraf band darwazon ki qatar aur daayin taraf andhera lawn aur khadi hui ek cycle.

alt.en: Close-up of metal shelves crammed with stacks of old, frayed magazines fading into blur, with a bright window out of focus on the left.
alt.hg: Purani, ghisi hui magazines ke dheron se thasathas bhari lohe ki shelves ka close-up, jo dhundhlepan mein khota jaata hai; baayin taraf ek chamakti khidki dhundhli dikh rahi hai.

alt.en: A wall mural on a black background: two orange hands cradle a heart with the dark silhouette of a foetus inside, next to the blue Hindi slogan 'Beti hai to kal hai'.
alt.hg: Kaali background par bani deewar painting: do orange haath ek dil ko thaame hain jiske andar bhroon ki kaali aakriti hai, aur bagal mein neele aksharon mein naara likha hai — 'Beti hai to kal hai'.

alt.en: A large university building lit by yellow floodlights against a black night sky, its windows glowing blue, with dark trees in front and one small figure walking past.
alt.hg: Raat ke kaale aasmaan ke saamne peeli floodlights se roshan university ki ek badi imaarat, jiski khidkiyan neeli chamak rahi hain; saamne andhere ped aur paas se guzarti ek chhoti-si aakriti.

alt.en: A long, empty aisle between tall metal stacks of old bound volumes in a library store, with a wire book trolley in front and red fire buckets on the wall.
alt.hg: Library ke store mein purani jildband kitabon se bhari oonchi lohe ki racks ke beech ek lamba, khaali raasta; aage taar ki ek trolley aur deewar par laal fire baaltiyan.

alt.en: A large blue roadside billboard at dusk with a cartoon of a girl's eyes and braids against a red sun, a Tamil slogan above and 'GIRL CHILD IS PRECIOUS' in red capitals below.
alt.hg: Shaam ke waqt sadak kinare ka ek bada neela hoarding, jis par laal sooraj ke saamne ek bachchi ki aankhon aur chotiyon ka cartoon hai; upar Tamil mein naara aur neeche laal bade aksharon mein 'GIRL CHILD IS PRECIOUS' likha hai.

alt.en: A long row of worn backpacks lined up on a concrete ledge in patchy sunlight, seen from above, with fallen leaves on the paving below.
alt.hg: Dhoop-chhaon mein concrete ki munder par ek qatar mein rakhe ghise hue school bags, upar se dikhte hue; neeche farsh par giri sookhi pattiyan.

alt.en: A domed, floodlit hospital building against a black night sky, with lit shop signs along the street below.
alt.hg: Raat ke kaale aasmaan ke neeche roshni mein dikhti gumbadon wali hospital building, neeche sadak par dukaanon ke jagmagate board.

alt.en: A weathered, stained single-storey health centre with metal grille doors, seen between tree trunks, with bamboo poles stacked in the foreground.
alt.hg: Pedon ke tanon ke beech se dikhta ek purana, daag-bhara ek-manzila health centre, jismein lohe ki jaali wale darwaze hain; aage baans ke khambe pade hain.

alt.en: Tall white columns and a carved triangular pediment of an old neoclassical hospital building, partly shaded by a dark tree, with wide steps in front.
alt.hg: Purani neoclassical style ki hospital building ke oonche safed khambe aur nakkashidar trikon jaisa chhajja, ek ghane ped ki chhaya mein; saamne chaudi seedhiyaan.

alt.en: A hospital corridor with a door marked 'Labour Room-1' in English and Hindi, a direction sign to the operation theatres, and a computer on a mobile stand.
alt.hg: Hospital ka corridor: English aur Hindi mein 'Labour Room-1' likha darwaza, operation theatre ki taraf ishara karta board aur mobile stand par rakha computer.

alt.en: Close view of an ultrasound machine's control panel and keyboard, with an empty examination couch blurred in the background.
alt.hg: Ultrasound machine ke control panel aur keyboard ka close-up, peeche blur mein dikhta khaali check-up bed.

alt.en: Two silver blister packs on purple cloth, each holding one round tablet marked 'Mifepristone 200mg' and four oval tablets marked 'Misoprostol 200mcg'.
alt.hg: Purple kapde par do silver blister pack; har pack mein 'Mifepristone 200mg' wali ek gol goli aur 'Misoprostol 200mcg' wali chaar oval goliyan hain.

alt.en: A white and lilac pregnancy test stick on a white surface, its result window showing two lines next to the words 'Not pregnant' and 'Pregnant'.
alt.hg: White surface par rakhi white aur lilac pregnancy test stick; uski window mein do lines dikh rahi hain aur paas mein 'Not pregnant' aur 'Pregnant' likha hai.

alt.en: Black-and-white close-up of a birth control pill blister pack, the foil torn open over many of its pockets.
alt.hg: Contraceptive goliyon ke blister pack ka black-and-white close-up; kai khaanon ki foil phati hui hai.

alt.en: A small T-shaped copper IUD with copper wire coiled around its stem and two long blue threads, on a plain white background.
alt.hg: White background par chhota T-shape wala Copper-T (IUD), jiski dandi par taambe ka taar lipta hai aur do lambe neele dhaage lage hain.

alt.en: A small plastic vial labelled 'OraSure HIV-1 Oral Specimen Vial' lying next to a sealed collection pad on a dark surface.
alt.hg: Dark surface par 'OraSure HIV-1 Oral Specimen Vial' likhi chhoti plastic vial, paas mein seal-band sample lene wala pad.

health-12.author: NIAID (National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases)

alt.en: A safety pin threaded with white beads in which red beads form the looped red ribbon symbol of HIV/AIDS awareness.
alt.hg: Safety pin mein piroye safed moti, jinke beech laal moti HIV/AIDS awareness ka red ribbon nishaan banate hain.

alt.en: A tall, ornately carved dark wooden double door under a sunburst stained-glass arch, fastened with two small padlocks, beside a pale blue iron pillar in dappled shade.
alt.hg: Dhoop-chhaanv mein, halke neele lohe ke khambe ke paas, gehre rang ki nakkashidaar lakdi ka ooncha dohra darwaza; upar suraj ki kirnon jaisa rangeen kaanch ka mehraab, aur darwaze par do chhote taale.

alt.en: Rusty, dented kerosene stoves of different shapes on a dark wooden shelf, with battered metal kerosene tins lined up on the floor below.
alt.hg: Gehre rang ki lakdi ki shelf par alag-alag aakaar ke zang lage, pichke kerosene stove, aur neeche farsh par qataar mein rakhe kerosene ke purane tin.

alt.en: Two tall, cracked wooden gate leaves, patched with planks and iron straps, stand slightly ajar in a faded yellow wall; through the gap a brick wall and a tree are visible.
alt.hg: Pheeki peeli deewar mein thode khule khade, daraaron bhare lakdi ke do oonche phaatak, jin par takhte aur lohe ki pattiyan jadi hain; beech ki daraar se us paar eent ki deewar aur ped dikhte hain.

alt.en: Two hands covered in dark henna patterns and wearing green and gold bangles knot a white cotton thread, holding a piece of turmeric root, around another person's wrist.
alt.hg: Gehri mehendi se saje, hari aur sunehri choodiyan pehne do haath doosre vyakti ki kalaai par haldi ki gaanth wala safed sooti dhaaga baandh rahe hain.

alt.en: Two cupped palms covered in intricate orange-brown henna, fingertips stained dark, with red, green and gold bangles at the wrists, resting on a green-and-gold silk saree.
alt.hg: Baareek naarangi-bhoori mehendi se bhari do judi hatheliyan, ungliyon ke sire gehre range, kalaaiyon par laal, hari aur sunehri choodiyan; neeche hari-sunehri reshmi saree.

alt.en: Rows of glossy red bangles packed tightly in open cardboard boxes, some still wrapped in clear plastic.
alt.hg: Khule gatte ke dibbon mein kaskar rakhi chamakdaar laal choodiyon ki qataarein, kuch ab bhi paardarshi plastic mein lipti hui.

alt.en: A long fabric tunnel hung with hundreds of blue LED lights glows at night; dark silhouettes of guests' heads fill the bottom of the frame, and a brightly lit stage shows at the far end.
alt.hg: Raat mein saikdon neeli LED lights se saji kapde ki lambi surang jagmaga rahi hai; neeche mehmaanon ke siron ki kaali parchhaiyan hain aur door sire par roshni se bhara manch dikhta hai.

alt.en: The domed Supreme Court of India sits low on the horizon under a wide, hazy grey evening sky, behind an iron fence, hedges and a row of parked cars.
alt.hg: Shaam ke dhundhle, grey aasmaan ke neeche door dikhti gumbad wali Supreme Court of India ki building, aage lohe ki railing, jhaadiyan aur khadi gaadiyon ki line.

alt.en: Raw concrete at the Punjab and Haryana High Court: a sloping ramp wall runs beside a tall, shaded wall cut with round and oval openings, while sharp diagonal bands of sunlight and shadow cross a white wall on the left.
alt.hg: Punjab and Haryana High Court ka khurdura concrete: dhalaan wali ramp ki deewar ke bagal mein chhaon mein doobi, gol aur oval chhedon wali oonchi deewar, jabki left side ki safed deewar par dhoop aur chhaon ki teekhi tirchhi pattiyan pad rahi hain.

alt.en: A long, vaulted corridor in the Calcutta High Court, its pointed arches repeating into the distance, lined with pillars, empty wooden benches and chairs, and white marble busts on pedestals.
alt.hg: Calcutta High Court ka lamba, mehraabdaar galiyara, jiski nukeeli mehraabein door tak repeat hoti chali jaati hain; dono taraf khambe, khaali lakdi ki benches aur kursiyan, aur chabutron par safed marble ke busts.

alt.en: Seen from below against a white sky, a moss-stained stone figure of Justice holds up a pair of metal scales in one hand and grips a sword in the other; her eyes are not covered.
alt.hg: Neeche se, safed aasmaan ke saamne dikhti Justice ki kaai lagi patthar ki moorti, jo ek haath mein metal ka tarazu uthaye hai aur doosre haath mein talwar thaame hai; uski aankhon par patti nahi hai.

alt.en: A dark arch reading 'District Courts Building Complex, Rangareddy District' spans an entrance gate against a pale sky, framing silhouetted trees, a green shade net and an empty driveway with traffic cones.
alt.hg: Pheeke aasmaan ke saamne district court complex ka andhera arch wala gate, jis par English mein 'District Courts Building Complex, Rangareddy District' likha hai; beech se pedon ki kaali shakal, hari shade-net aur traffic cones wala khaali raasta dikhta hai.

alt.en: The stone building of Police Station Connaught Place, New Delhi, half hidden by trees, with its name on the wall and on the facade, and yellow 'Delhi Police' barricades beside an empty road with black-and-yellow kerbs.
alt.hg: Pedon ke peeche aadhi chhupi Police Station Connaught Place, New Delhi ki patthar ki building; deewar aur front par thane ka naam, aur kaale-peele kinare wali khaali sadak ke paas peele 'Delhi Police' barricades.

alt.en: Night, seen from above: a white Kolkata Police PCR van marked 'Dial 100' waits at an almost empty crossing beside a traffic police kiosk with a 'Women Self Defense Workshop' poster, with 'No Entry' barricades and street lamps behind.
alt.hg: Raat ka upar se liya gaya scene: lagbhag khaali chauraahe par 'Dial 100' likhi Kolkata Police ki safed PCR van, paas mein traffic police booth jis par women self-defence workshop ka poster laga hai, aur peeche 'No Entry' barricades aur street lights.

alt.en: A blue Kolkata Police signboard reading 'Ultadanga Women Police Station' on a cream building, seen from under a corrugated metal shed, with tangled wires, a lamp, an air-conditioner unit and the black roof of a parked vehicle.
alt.hg: Cream rang ki building par Kolkata Police ka neela board, jis par 'Ultadanga Women Police Station' likha hai; tin ke shed ke neeche se dikhta hua, saath mein uljhe taar, ek lamp, AC ki outdoor unit aur khadi gaadi ki kaali chhat.

alt.en: A yellow steel-mesh barricade on small wheels, painted in red with 'Delhi Police' and 'PS Parliament Street', stands at the edge of a tree-lined road in New Delhi.
alt.hg: Chhote pahiyon par khada peela loha-jaali wala barricade, jis par laal rang se 'Delhi Police' aur 'PS Parliament Street' likha hai, New Delhi ki pedon wali sadak ke kinare.

alt.en: Gloved hands press loose cotton into an aluminium mould with four pad-shaped hollows; a digital scale with a red bowl stands behind on a blue worktable.
alt.hg: Dastaane pehne haath aluminium ke ek saanche mein rui daba rahe hain, jismein pad ke shape ke chaar khaanche hain; peeche neeli table par laal katore wala digital taraazu rakha hai.

alt.en: Two women in teal aprons, face masks and gloves stand at steel machines in a whitewashed workshop; behind them, shelves and the floor are piled with folded white cloth, and two more women sit among the stacks beside a row of sewing machines.
alt.hg: Safedi wali workshop mein firozi apron, mask aur dastaane pehne do mahilayein steel ki machines par kaam kar rahi hain; peeche shelves aur farsh par tah kiye hue safed kapde ke dher lage hain, aur silaai machines ki qataar ke paas do aur mahilayein in dheron ke beech baithi hain.

alt.en: Close-up of hands against dark clothing holding a boxed menstrual cup and a green leaflet reading “Hablemos de menstruación” (“Let's talk about menstruation”) above a white cloth bag printed with a helpline message about gender violence.
alt.hg: Dark kapdon ke saamne haathon ka close-up: ek haath mein dabbe mein band menstrual cup aur doosre mein hara parcha, jis par Spanish mein “chaliye periods par baat karein” likha hai; neeche safed kapde ka thaila hai jis par gender violence helpline ka message chhapa hai.

alt.en: A cream-coloured, wall-mounted “Automatic Barrywald Incinerator” inside a clear display case against a red wall; handwritten German graffiti on its front reads “Achtung Ekel ruft!” (“Warning, disgust calls!”), and a “Please do not flush” sign hangs nearby.
alt.hg: Laal deewar ke saamne transparent showcase mein deewar par lagne wala cream rang ka “Automatic Barrywald Incinerator”; uske aage German mein haath se likha hai “saavdhaan, ghin pukaar rahi hai!”, aur paas mein “Please do not flush” ka board tanga hai.

alt.en: Activists in face masks sit cross-legged on a huge purple, white and red cloth shaped like a sanitary pad, holding up pink placards with a drawing of a woman; historic stone buildings line the wide, almost empty square behind them.
alt.hg: Mask pehne activists sanitary pad ke shape ke baingani, safed aur laal rang ke vishaal kapde par paalthi maar kar baithe hain aur gulaabi takhtiyaan uthaaye hain, jin par ek mahila ka chitra bana hai; peeche chaude, lagbhag khaali chowk ke kinaare purani patthar ki imaaratein hain.

periods-07.author: Katherine Stone for International Citizen Service

alt.en: A woman in a patterned dress and headwrap smiles as she sews blue fabric on a black hand-cranked sewing machine; the chalkboard behind her lists “Plastic, Poppers, Thread, Cotton” with sums adding up to 7.00.
alt.hg: Printed dress aur sir par kapda baandhe ek mahila muskuraate hue haath se chalne wali kaali silaai machine par neela kapda sil rahi hai; peeche blackboard par “Plastic, Poppers, Thread, Cotton” aur unki laagat likhi hai, jiska jod 7.00 hai.

alt.en: A white cardboard box labelled “Donation Point for The Red Box Project” sits on a red ledge, packed with colourful packets of sanitary pads and tampons.
alt.hg: Laal patti par rakha safed gatte ka dabba, jis par “Donation Point for The Red Box Project” likha hai; usmein sanitary pads aur tampons ke rang-birange packet thasaathas bhare hain.

alt.en: A white sanitary pad and an unwrapped tampon lie on a spiral notebook on a wooden table; the page reads “Menstruar es político!” in red handwriting.
alt.hg: Lakdi ki table par rakhi spiral notebook par ek safed sanitary pad aur bina wrapper ka tampon rakha hai; panne par laal rang se Spanish mein haath se likha hai “periods political hain!”.

alt.en: In dim blue light, a hand holds an unwrapped white sanitary pad; its peel-off strip is printed with front and back placement marks in Spanish, English and French.
alt.hg: Dheemi neeli roshni mein ek haath khula hua safed sanitary pad pakde hai; uski chipakne wali patti par Spanish, English aur French mein aage-peeche lagaane ke nishaan chhape hain.

alt.en: A huge rainbow flag ripples over a road as marchers, seen mostly from behind, carry it beneath tall trees toward a high-rise tower.
alt.hg: Ek bahut bada rainbow jhanda sadak par lehra raha hai; zyaadatar peeche se dikhte log use oonche pedon ke neeche se ek oonchi building ki taraf le ja rahe hain.

alt.en: At night, a speaker holding a microphone stands before a white colonnaded pavilion beneath a protest banner, as people sit on the ground among rows of small candles.
alt.hg: Raat mein safed khambhon wale mandap ke saamne mic thaame ek speaker, peeche protest ka banner; chhoti-chhoti candles ki kataaron ke beech zameen par baithe log.

alt.en: A modernist building's lattice facade glows in bands of rainbow light at night, mirrored in a dark pool with a fountain in front.
alt.hg: Raat mein ek modern building ki jaalidaar deewar rainbow roshni ki pattiyon mein chamak rahi hai, jiska aks saamne ke andhere fountain wale talaab mein dikh raha hai.

alt.en: The back of a shaved head wearing a jewelled tiara, seen from behind beneath a glowing orange flag, among dark silhouettes.
alt.hg: Munde hue sir ka pichhla hissa, jis par nagon se jada mukut hai; upar chamakta orange jhanda aur aaspaas andheri parchhaiyan.

alt.en: Backlit marchers walk away down a sunlit road, their long shadows stretching across the asphalt; one carries a small rainbow flag.
alt.hg: Peeche se aati dhoop mein sadak par aage badhte log, jinki lambi parchhaiyan sadak par phaili hain; ek ke haath mein chhota rainbow jhanda hai.

alt.en: Marchers hold a long banner reading 'Delhi Queer Pride 2023' in English and Hindi under an arch of balloons, with a Delhi Police bus parked behind them.
alt.hg: Gubbaaron ke mehraab ke neeche log 'Delhi Queer Pride 2023' likha lamba banner thaame hain; peeche Delhi Police ki bus khadi hai.

alt.en: A packed crowd of young protesters, mostly seen from behind, faces the domed sandstone North Block; an Indian flag is raised above their heads, more people line the top of the wall and helmeted police stand beside police vehicles at the left.
alt.hg: Young protesters ki khachakhach bheed, zyada tar peeche se dikhti hui, gumbad wali sandstone North Block building ki taraf dekh rahi hai; sar ke upar tiranga lehra raha hai, deewar ke upar bhi log khade hain aur left side police ki gaadiyon ke paas helmet pehne policewale khade hain.

alt.en: On a wet road, a protester holds a blue handmade sign reading 'INDIA IS RAPED' above their head; another sign beside it asks 'WHY IS THE PM MUM?', with a crowd and government buildings in the haze behind.
alt.hg: Geeli sadak par ek protester sar ke upar neele rang ki haath se likhi takhti uthaye hai, jis par likha hai 'INDIA IS RAPED'; bagal wali takhti poochhti hai 'WHY IS THE PM MUM?', peeche dhundh mein bheed aur sarkari buildings hain.

alt.en: White teargas smoke billows beside one of the domed sandstone Secretariat buildings on Raisina Hill while scattered protesters walk away across a wide, sunlit road; TV broadcast vans with satellite dishes stand at the right.
alt.hg: Raisina Hill par gumbad wali sandstone Secretariat buildings mein se ek ke paas teargas ka safed dhuaan uth raha hai aur bikhre hue protesters dhoop mein chaudi sadak par door ja rahe hain; right side satellite dish wali TV broadcast vans khadi hain.

alt.en: Young protesters and camera crews crowd the roof of a dark-blue Delhi Police bus, raising placards and a white flag in front of the domed North Block, with the heads of a crowd in the foreground.
alt.hg: Young protesters aur camera crews Delhi Police ki dark blue bus ki chhat par khade hain aur gumbad wali North Block building ke saamne takhtiyan aur safed jhanda uthaye hue hain; aage bheed ke sar dikh rahe hain.

alt.en: Dark silhouettes of women holding sheets of paper stand in a row at a microphone; orange projected letters reading 'STOP THIS HATRED!' fall across their clothes.
alt.hg: Andhere mein kaagaz thaame auraton ki parchhaiyan microphone ke paas line mein khadi hain; unke kapdon par orange roshni se 'STOP THIS HATRED!' likha dikh raha hai.

alt.en: At night, a uniformed security guard leans over a large paper sheet held up by a man in glasses; it reads 'ATTENTION PLEASE! YOU JUST STAND THERE WATCHING A WOMAN BEING ASSAULTED BECAUSE:' above tick-box excuses such as 'IT'S NONE OF MY BUSINESS' and 'I DON'T WANT TO MAKE A SCENE'.
alt.hg: Raat mein chashma pehne ek aadmi kaagaz ki badi sheet uthaye hai aur uniform pehne ek security guard us par jhuka hai; sheet par likha hai 'ATTENTION PLEASE! YOU JUST STAND THERE WATCHING A WOMAN BEING ASSAULTED BECAUSE:' aur neeche tick karne ke liye bahaane hain, jaise 'IT'S NONE OF MY BUSINESS' aur 'I DON'T WANT TO MAKE A SCENE'.

alt.en: Women activists holding placards marked NFIW and AIMSS speak into a cluster of microphones and phones held out by reporters; uniformed security personnel sit along a brick wall behind them.
alt.hg: NFIW aur AIMSS likhi takhtiyan thaame mahila activists reporters ke mic aur phones ke jhund ke saamne bol rahi hain; peeche eent ki deewar ke paas uniform mein security personnel baithe hain.

alt.en: Black-and-white wide view of a huge crowd at night beneath a giant ring-shaped structure on slanting pillars with a spiral staircase, floodlights glowing on both sides.
alt.hg: Raat mein bahut badi bheed ka black-and-white wide view, jiske upar tirchhe khambhon par tiki ek badi ring jaisi structure aur ghumaavdaar seedhi hai; dono taraf floodlights jal rahi hain.

alt.en: Black-and-white close view of a handmade placard reading 'WE WANT JUSTICE' planted in grass behind a row of burning candles, with more placards lying crumpled on the ground.
alt.hg: Black-and-white photo: ghaas mein gadi haath se likhi takhti 'WE WANT JUSTICE', aage jalti mombattiyon ki line aur zameen par padi kuch aur mudi-tudi takhtiyan.

alt.en: At night, a young woman crouches to light rows of white candles on the steps and pavement in front of a closed metal gate; a banner above reads 'NO SAFETY NO DUTY'.
alt.hg: Raat mein ek young woman band lohe ke gate ke saamne seedhiyon aur footpath par safed mombattiyon ki lines jalaane ke liye jhuki hai; upar banner par likha hai 'NO SAFETY NO DUTY'.

alt.en: A crowd of women seen from behind fills a street at night, some raising fists and phones towards a lit gathering ahead; a white police car is parked at the left.
alt.hg: Raat mein sadak par auraton ki bheed peeche se dikh rahi hai, kuch aage ki roshni wali sabha ki taraf mutthiyan aur phone uthaye hain; left side police ki safed gaadi khadi hai.
